page.title: Your Privacy Rights
page.subtitle: California residents have the right to know, delete, and opt out under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
page.contactNotice: For questions, contact us at privacy@realdesk.us
page.invalidOrgMessage: This privacy page requires a valid organization link from your real estate agent (for example /privacy?org=…). You can still check the status of an existing request below. Contact your agent if you need a new link to submit a request.

know.title: Right to Know
know.description: Request information about what personal data we collect, use, share, or sell about you.

delete.title: Right to Delete
delete.description: Request that we delete personal information we've collected from you, subject to certain exceptions.

optOut.title: Right to Opt-Out
optOut.description: Opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information to third parties.

nonDiscrimination.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
nonDiscrimination.description: We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your CCPA rights.

whoQualifies.q: Who can submit a CCPA request?
whoQualifies.a: California residents whose personal information has been collected by a business using RealDesk can submit requests.

howLong.a: We aim to respond within 45 days. If more time is needed, we'll notify you and may extend by another 45 days.

whatData.q: What personal data does RealDesk collect?
whatData.a: Contact information (name, email, phone), transaction history, property preferences, and communication records related to real estate services.

verification.q: Why do you need to verify my identity?
verification.a: Identity verification helps protect your privacy and ensures requests are fulfilled only for the correct individual.

requestTypeDescriptions.know: Request a copy of the personal information collected about you.
requestTypeDescriptions.delete: Request deletion of your personal information from our records.
requestTypeDescriptions.opt_out_sale: Opt out of the sale of your personal information.
requestTypeDescriptions.opt_out_share: Opt out of sharing your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising.
requestTypeDescriptions.correct: Request correction of inaccurate personal information.
